validity_envelope.disclaimer: Both the ~32 percent criteria-count figure and the ~57 percent issue-volume figure are vendor-reported by Deque, not independently audited. A structural pass is not usable, is not good UI. This is not a WCAG conformance certification.

findings.detail: S38/CR5-B6: a genuine main-content-missing defect whose S35 code->severity lookup was corrupted (mis-mapped to 3 instead of 4). A gate that blocks on the derived severity integer never fires; a gate that reads the code directly still blocks. structural-ci-diff.mjs invoked standalone must exit non-zero on the code, not the severity.
